description: Exploratory evaluation fixtures for MTalk driver communication scenarios across VI->EN and EN->VI language pairs.
privacy_statement: All fixtures are driver-authored or synthetic. No live passenger recordings, ride transcripts, or personal data are included.

fixtures.source_utterance: Bạn muốn thanh toán bằng tiền mặt hay chuyển khoản?
fixtures.intended_meaning: Inquire whether passenger will settle fare using physical cash or electronic bank transfer
fixtures.expected_translation: Would you like to pay with cash or bank transfer?
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger selects payment method, prepares cash or opens banking/QR app
fixtures.notes: Core payment coordination. Misidentifying cash vs transfer causes payment dispute.

fixtures.source_utterance: Hết năm mươi nghìn đồng nhé bạn.
fixtures.intended_meaning: State that the total fare amount is 50,000 VND
fixtures.expected_translation: The total is fifty thousand dong.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger provides 50,000 VND note or initiates 50,000 VND transfer
fixtures.notes: Numeric currency clarity. Translation must accurately preserve the 50,000 quantity.

fixtures.source_utterance: Mình đến nơi rồi, bạn xuống ở cổng này hay cổng bên kia?
fixtures.intended_meaning: Confirm arrival at destination and ask which specific gate passenger prefers for drop-off
fixtures.expected_translation: We have arrived. Would you like to get off at this gate or the other one?
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger indicates or points to preferred gate for disembarking
fixtures.notes: Destination coordination during stationary pause before unlocking doors.

fixtures.source_utterance: Bạn quét mã QR ở trên taplo giúp tôi nhé.
fixtures.intended_meaning: Instruct passenger to scan the payment QR code mounted on vehicle dashboard
fixtures.expected_translation: Please scan the QR code on the dashboard.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger aims smartphone camera at dashboard QR standee
fixtures.notes: Action instruction. 'Taplo' is standard Vietnamese loanword for dashboard.

fixtures.source_utterance: Tôi đang đỗ xe ở sảnh B, ngay trước cột số bốn.
fixtures.intended_meaning: Clarify current stationary parked pickup location at Lobby B in front of pillar 4
fixtures.expected_translation: I am parked at Lobby B, right in front of pillar number four.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger identifies driver vehicle at designated pickup pillar

fixtures.source_utterance: Đoạn đường phía trước đang bị kẹt xe, mình đi chậm một chút nhé.
fixtures.intended_meaning: Inform passenger of traffic congestion ahead causing vehicle slowdown
fixtures.expected_translation: There is a traffic jam ahead, so we will be moving a bit slowly.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger understands rationale for slow movement or pause
fixtures.notes: Driver reassurance during stationary or creeping traffic conditions.

fixtures.source_utterance: Bạn cứ để hành lý vào cốp sau, tôi đợi bạn được.
fixtures.intended_meaning: Reassure passenger to load luggage into the trunk without rushing
fixtures.expected_translation: Please put your luggage in the trunk, take your time.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger loads bags into trunk comfortably before boarding

fixtures.source_utterance: Xin lỗi, tiếng ồn quá tôi nghe không rõ, bạn nói lại giúp tôi được không?
fixtures.intended_meaning: Politely ask passenger to repeat utterance due to ambient noise interference
fixtures.expected_translation: Sorry, it is too noisy and I could not hear clearly. Could you please repeat that?
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger repeats previous phrase more distinctly or points to screen
fixtures.notes: Essential fallback utterance when in-cabin or exterior noise degrades audio.

fixtures.source_utterance: Máy lạnh trong xe có bị lạnh quá không bạn?
fixtures.intended_meaning: Ask if the vehicle air conditioning temperature is too cold for comfort
fixtures.expected_translation: Is the air conditioning in the car too cold for you?
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger gestures or confirms AC comfort level

fixtures.source_utterance: Bạn kiểm tra lại điện thoại và hành lý trước khi xuống xe nhé.
fixtures.intended_meaning: Remind passenger to verify personal belongings before leaving vehicle
fixtures.expected_translation: Please check your phone and luggage before getting out of the car.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger checks seat and pockets for phone, wallet, and bags

fixtures.source_utterance: Chào bạn, mình bắt đầu đi đến khách sạn nhé.
fixtures.intended_meaning: Greet passenger and confirm starting trip toward destination hotel
fixtures.expected_translation: Hello, let us head to the hotel now.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Passenger nods or confirms trip start

fixtures.source_utterance: Please pull over and stop right here, this is urgent.
fixtures.intended_meaning: Request driver to safely pull over to curbside immediately due to urgent situation
fixtures.expected_translation: Làm ơn tấp vào lề và dừng lại ngay đây, có việc gấp.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Driver checks mirrors and safely maneuvers to curbside to stop
fixtures.notes: Urgent vehicle maneuver instruction. Must be translated without hesitation or distortion.

fixtures.source_utterance: I only have cash, do you have change for a five hundred thousand note?
fixtures.intended_meaning: Inform driver payment is cash-only and ask if driver can break a 500,000 VND bill
fixtures.expected_translation: Tôi chỉ có tiền mặt, bạn có tiền thối cho tờ năm trăm nghìn không?
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Driver checks cash box for change or suggests electronic alternative
fixtures.notes: Critical cash transaction coordination. Preserves 500,000 denomination.

fixtures.source_utterance: Please drop me off at the International Terminal, Terminal 2.
fixtures.intended_meaning: Instruct driver to navigate to International Terminal (Terminal 2) at airport
fixtures.expected_translation: Làm ơn cho tôi xuống ở Ga Quốc Tế, Nhà ga số 2.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Driver aligns vehicle with Terminal 2 access lane
fixtures.notes: High-cost error scenario: landing passenger at wrong airport terminal causes missed flights.

fixtures.source_utterance: Can you please wait here for two minutes while I buy water?
fixtures.intended_meaning: Ask driver to remain stationary for two minutes for a quick store purchase
fixtures.expected_translation: Bạn có thể chờ ở đây hai phút để tôi mua nước được không?
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Driver keeps hazard lights on and holds parking spot
fixtures.notes: Coordination of brief operational wait while parked.

fixtures.source_utterance: Thank you very much for the ride, keep the change.
fixtures.intended_meaning: Express gratitude for trip and instruct driver to retain residual fare change
fixtures.expected_translation: Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì chuyến đi, bạn cứ giữ tiền thừa nhé.
fixtures.operational_action_or_meaning: Driver acknowledges tip, thanks passenger, completes transaction
fixtures.notes: Fare settlement completion and customary tip expression.
